agreement.title: Website Design Services Agreement
agreement.intro: This agreement is between {{business_legal_name}} ("the Provider") and {{client_name}}{{client_company_clause}} ("the Client"). By signing below you agree to the following terms.

clauses.heading: 1. Services
clauses.body: The Provider will design and build a website for the Client based on the discovery brief agreed on {{date}} and the selected package: {{package_name}}. Reasonable revisions are included; substantial changes to the agreed scope may be quoted separately.

clauses.heading: 2. Fees & deposit
clauses.body: The total fee is {{package_price}}. A deposit of {{deposit_amount}} is payable to begin work and is non-refundable once design work has started. The balance is due on completion, before the site is handed over or made live.

clauses.heading: 3. Client responsibilities
clauses.body: The Client will provide content (text, images, logos) and timely feedback. Delays in providing materials may move the delivery date. The Client confirms they own or are licensed to use all materials supplied.

clauses.heading: 4. Timescales
clauses.body: An indicative go-live date will be agreed. Timescales depend on the Client providing content and feedback promptly.

clauses.heading: 5. Intellectual property
clauses.body: On full payment, ownership of the final website design and content created for the Client transfers to the Client. The Provider may display the work in its portfolio unless the Client requests otherwise in writing.

clauses.heading: 6. Third-party costs
clauses.body: Domain names, hosting, premium plugins, stock imagery and similar third-party costs are not included unless stated and are passed on at cost or arranged by the Client.

clauses.heading: 7. Cancellation
clauses.body: Either party may cancel in writing. Fees for work completed up to cancellation remain payable; the deposit is non-refundable once work has begun.

clauses.heading: 8. Liability
clauses.body: The Provider's total liability under this agreement is limited to the fees paid by the Client. The Provider is not liable for indirect or consequential losses.

clauses.heading: 9. Data protection
clauses.body: Both parties will comply with UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018. Personal data shared for the project is used only to deliver the services.

clauses.heading: 10. Governing law
clauses.body: This agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales and the courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction.

agreement.signature_statement: I confirm I have read and agree to this agreement. I intend this to be my electronic signature and I agree to be legally bound by it.
